intermediate.name: Passo di San Valentino
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Passo di San Valentino (203 km)

story: Stage 16 featured over 4,700 metres of climbing and began in the rain, with an immediate fight for the breakaway. A group of six went clear and was later joined by a big chase group. Roglič had to abandon the race after a crash. On the penultimate climb, Ayuso couldn’t follow the pace and dropped. As the race hit the final climb, Scaroni attacked from the break, with teammate Fortunato bridging across. The Astana duo stayed together and crossed the line side by side, Scaroni taking the win. Behind, Carapaz gained time in the GC, while Del Toro struggled and lost time.
